decisions.reason: As an organic line extension that remained on the website across 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's stated expansion in organic products and still looks worth carrying.
Its reduced prominence in 2024 suggests only moderate traction, but as a close-to-core snack format in a growing market it still has enough option value to retain for now.
This newly launched organic sausage is very close to the established range and strategic direction, so the uncertainty is still worth bearing given likely low incremental carrying costs.
The new organic thin-sliced chicken breast extends the assortment toward ingredient-conscious buyers and should be kept while the firm learns its retail pull.
Although the herb-coated organic salami is a somewhat narrower flavor variant, it is newly launched, close to core capabilities, and still merits staying on the market until demand becomes clearer.
